blocks.text: Debuggers woh tools hain jo developers ko apne code mein errors (bugs) dhoondne aur theek karne mein madad dete hain. Debuggers ka maqsad developers ko apna code test karne aur yeh pehchanne dena hai ke errors kahan aate hain. Misalein:
GDB: C/C++ ke liye GNU Debugger.
Visual Studio Debugger: Visual Studio IDE ke andar shamil.

blocks.prompt: Debugger bug dhoondne mein kaise madad karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh developer ko program step by step chalane aur variables ki values dekhne deta hai, is liye woh line mil jati hai jahan program ghalat hota hai.

items: Debuggers: code test kar ke errors ki jagah dhoondne aur theek karne ke tools; GDB, Visual Studio Debugger.
